## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals confirm CAUTION: strong sector breadth (7/11) alongside clear leadership divergence where Industrials/Materials/Consumer Staples are ABOVE TREND while Big Tech and Financials show clustered weakness.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Staples lead: MO (1W: +10.16% | 1M: +6.12%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +2.06%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +20.55%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +9.74%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials weak: WFC (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -4.24%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND. Technology and Communication are under pressure with MSFT (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +13.29% | 1M: +22.13%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +9.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +26.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: WFC (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -4.24%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -3.25%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech/Healthcare names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strong 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +13.29% | 1M: +22.13%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +9.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +26.49%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR divergence present — hardware/commodity names surging while mega-cap software and payments names are collapsing, so treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed and under internal rotation: NVDA (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.10%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -13.40%) BELOW TREND and CRM (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W performance: -0.74% across 19 stocks, watch semiconductor/hardware leadership versus app/software weakness.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are under pressure overall with JPM (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND and WFC (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -4.24%) BELOW TREND. Despite positive deal-flow headlines for parts of the industry, sector 1W performance is -2.20% across 20 stocks and remains a late-cyclical area to monitor for follow-through.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows mixed/defensive pockets: JNJ (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +2.52%) ABOVE TREND but UNH (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND and ISRG (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -3.25%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.15% across 15 stocks; watch earnings/regulatory headlines for episodic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals/value exposure into Industrials and Materials: LMT (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +20.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +26.49%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to stretched software/payments names showing sharp 1W weakness (ADBE, CRM, QCOM, INTU) and monitor liquidity in mega-cap Tech for confirmation.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +13.29% | 1M: +22.13%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -13.40%) BELOW TREND for risk of further downside.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials and Materials where breadth is strong and several names are ABOVE TREND (LMT, BA, FCX). BEARISH: Financials and select Technology pockets where cluster weakness could pressure indices if it broadens.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.10%) ABOVE TREND — watch hold above recent swing highs for continuation. AAPL (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND — monitor prior monthly low as a tactical support test. INTC (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through from this week’s breakout as confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LOW (+50): LOW (1W: +8.12% | 1M: +11.35%) ABOVE TREND — analyst upgrade aligns with price strength and confirms accumulation. EQIX (+50) appears in the sentiment feed but lacks dual-timeframe in the dataset for full cross-check; monitor for confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (-50): LLY (1W: -4.81% | 1M: -2.75%) BELOW TREND — negative FDA/coverage headlines confirm price weakness. TSLA (-50): TSLA (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -7.73%) RECOVERY — negative sentiment diverges from a 1W bounce, watch for distribution. ISRG (-45): ISRG (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -3.25%) BELOW TREND — sentiment matches price deterioration.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style: Value/Cyclical tilt as Industrials, Materials and Consumer Staples lead. INTC (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +26.49%) ABOVE TREND and LMT (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is leadership narrowness and a major divergence between surging hardware/commodity names and broad weakness in mega-cap software/payments, with negative sentiment on several Healthcare and Consumer names to monitor.
